thread:
Ravi M: Heads-up - Stonebridge sent an RFI. They want: capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, a 2-week POC showing HSM-backed key usage + strict data residency (eu-central), and SLOs (95p latency <120ms). Deadline EOD tomorrow. Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/stonebridge/rfi. Can we field this? cc @Elena @Tom
Elena V: We can do a POC but need to clarify "HSM-backed" — do they mean external customer HSM or cloud HSM (CMEK) for Dedicated? That changes architecture and cost. Also they require egress controls (no internet egress).
Tom S: We support both patterns: (1) Hosted/Dedicated: CMEK via AWS KMS / GCP CMEK (no external HSM). (2) Private/on-prem or VPC with customer HSM via PKCS#11 (requires SOW & on-prem connectivity). For the POC that demonstrates HSM, recommend Private VPC peering + PKCS#11 mount in their infra or a short-lived on-prem rack. Adds ~5 business days to set up.
Jules P: Security asks also include live audit during POC, key rotation policy, proof of data deletion at teardown, and a requirement for a runbook for incident response. I have a one-pager we can adapt. Also they asked about encryption of cache/KV stores.
infra-bot: Reservation check: two A40-equivalent hosts available in eu-central for a 14-day window starting 2026-04-12 pending PO. Note: VPC peering requires customer's network team to provision routes and allow PKCS#11 endpoint. Monitoring: we can enable per-route real-time metrics and export to their SIEM.
Ravi M: Pricing thoughts: propose two packages in RFI: (A) Private POC (HSM demo): one-time setup SOW $18k + $9k/week infra; (B) Hosted Dedicated pilot: $7k/week (CMEK) + overage $0.00065/token. Include optional add-on: runbook & live audit support at $2k/day. Sarah (pricing) - can you sanity-check?
Elena V: For capability matrix rows: "HSM-backed keys (Private only)", "CMEK support (Dedicated)", "regional inference nodes", "no-internet egress during POC", "key rotation / rotation cadence", "data deletion proof". I'll draft matrix and attach.
Tom S: Example rollout snippet for fallback policy to capture reliability ask: ``fallback_policy:
  - prefer: redwood-xlarge
    fallback: redwood-medium
    conditions: [gpu_util>85, queue_time>150ms]`` Note: tokenization compatibility must be validated across variants.
Jules P: RFI snippet for security answers: ``HSM: Customer HSMs are supported for Private deployments via PKCS#11 integration; Hosted Dedicated supports CMEK (cloud KMS). SOC2 Type II (2024) and penetration test summary are available under NDA. Audit logs can be exported to customer S3/GCS or forwarded to SIEM. Data deletion: ephemeral caches cleared at POC teardown and certifiable deletion procedures available in SOW.``
legal-bot: NDA required before sharing SOC2 and pentest artifacts. I can auto-send NDA template to Stonebridge once sales confirms.
Ravi M: Action items: Tom - confirm infra pricing & node reservation; Elena - update capability matrix and attach to drive (mark pricing provisional); Jules - finalize security snippets and include data-deletion language; legal-bot - stand by to issue NDA; Sarah - confirm pricing numbers and discount authority. Target: send provisional package by 09:00 tomorrow. Keep replies concise. :white_check_mark:
